crops.text: (1GCD) You may receive points for completing one of the following challenges. 1: (3 points) Use an action to place your lowest star-level creature on the field into defense mode.2: (4 points) Deal less than 10 total DMG this global turn.3: (4 points) Attack the same creature with all of your creatures.4: (4 points) Attack different creatures with all of your creatures.5: (4 points) Get an exact kill.6: (5 points) Don't use any SP this global turn.
